description: Integrity proof for a plugin-owned file rendered from durable semantic rows without a binary CAS payload.

id.description: File primary-key value (matches lix_file.id) for this derived materialization.

path.description: Exact absolute lix_file path supplied to the renderer that produced this proof.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes rendered from the semantic rows.

size_bytes.description: Exact byte length of the rendered file.
